pc_convention: Corpus PCs include two prefetched words: subtract 4 and mask the 24-bit bus. A stopped supervisor STOP performs no new prefetch; its final PC already points to the following instruction.
scope: Register values, complete final listed RAM and total clocks. Prefetch contents and bus transaction ordering are not compared.
excluded: Post-instruction trace delivery (not emitted by this single-step oracle), odd-address/bus errors, later CPUs, TAS, TRAPV and nonzero divide timings. Authored Motorola-based cases cover trace, TRAPV and DIV zero separately.
